resources.string: Turn SIM lines on or off and open the mobile data SIM screen.
SIM lines and the mobile data SIM, plus Wi-Fi and mobile data cells that open the system panel.

Works only when you tap a SimTap widget cell. A SIM line cell opens the SIM manager screen, taps that SIM line switch once and taps OK once on the ordinary confirmation that follows. It does not tap a turn-on confirmation that also turns off another SIM, a confirmation with three buttons, or the eSIM reset screen. When it is done it returns to the home screen. The Data SIM cell only opens the Mobile data screen; you pick the SIM and apply it. The Wi-Fi and Data cells of the 5x1 widget do not use this service; they open the system panel. It reads only the SIM manager screen and remembers SIM names and on/off states to show on the widget.
The accessibility service is off. Opening the setup screen.
Turn on SimTap in Accessibility first.
Could not open the SIM manager screen. Change it yourself in Settings > Connections > SIM manager.
Could not find the switch for SIM %1$d. Tap it yourself on the screen that is open.
Could not find an available Mobile data row on the SIM manager screen. Both SIMs must be on to choose the mobile data SIM.
Turn SIM lines on or off and jump to the mobile data SIM screen from a home screen widget. SimTap opens the SIM manager screen and its accessibility service taps the switch for you.

On Android 13 and later, apps installed from outside an app store are blocked from accessibility until you allow them. Open App info, tap ⋮ at the top right, tap Allow restricted settings and verify. Then turn on SimTap in Accessibility. If the ⋮ menu has no Allow restricted settings, try turning on SimTap in Accessibility once first; the menu appears after it is blocked.

To add the widget, long-press an empty area of the home screen, open Widgets > SimTap and place it where you want. There are two: 4x1 (SIM lines and data SIM) and 5x1 (the same plus Wi-Fi and Data cells).
Opens the SIM manager screen without tapping anything so the widget can show SIM names and states. Go back when it opens.
No app can open this screen.
SimTap has no internet permission, so it can\'t check for or download new versions by itself.

1) Tap Check for updates to open the latest release page.
2) If the top version is newer than the version at the bottom of this screen, tap simtap-v<version>.apk to download it.
3) Turn off Scan apps with Play Protect for a moment and install it over the current app. Your settings and widget stay as they are.
For automatic update checks, add this repository to the Obtainium app.
Reading the current state. Tap again to switch once the widget shows it.
